title: Comparing SGLD and a fixed-noise predictor-corrector adaptation in canonical joint energy-based models on CIFAR-10
abstract: arXiv:2608.05025v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Joint Energy-Based Models (JEM) unify classification and generation within a single network and support out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. Canonical JEM training relies on stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD); a theoretically motivated alternative, the Predictor-Corrector (PC) sampler, has not previously undergone a systematic replication test on the canonical model. We reproduce canonical JEM on WideResNet-28-10 without normalisation layers on two independent runs and test a fixed-noise PC adaptation - with the degenerate annealed-noise predictor replaced by a deterministic gradient step - across three protocols: the adapted sampler replacing SGLD throughout the full training trajectories (115-132 epochs); cold-start generation (FID); and refinement-style multi-OOD detection (AUROC). translated_title: 在CIFAR-10上比较SGLD与固定噪声预测-校正采样器在经典联合能量模型中的改进应用
translated_abstract: 联合能量模型将分类与生成统一在单个网络中，并支持分布外（OOD）检测。经典的JEM训练依赖于随机梯度朗之万动力学（SGLD）；而一种有理论依据的替代方法——预测-校正（PC）采样器——此前尚未在经典模型上经过系统的复现检验。我们在两次独立运行中复现了基于WideResNet-28-10（不含归一化层）的经典JEM，并测试了一种固定噪声PC改进方法——用确定性梯度步骤替代存在缺陷的退火噪声预测器——涵盖三种协议：改进采样器在整个训练轨迹（115-132个epoch）中替代SGLD；冷启动生成（FID）；以及精炼式多OOD检测（AUROC）。复现结果达到92.88%的测试准确率和44.46的buffer-FID（经典方法为92.90%和38.40）。我们记录了两种失败模式：灾难性……
tldr: 该论文系统复现了经典联合能量模型（JEM），并首次检验了用固定噪声预测-校正采样器替代SGLD的效果，结果显示其分类性能接近经典方法但生成质量略有差距，同时记录了两种失败模式。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically replicates canonical JEM on CIFAR-10 and, for the first time, tests a fixed-noise predictor-corrector sampler as a replacement for SGLD, finding near-canonical classification accuracy but slightly worse generation quality, while documenting two failure modes.
